findings.message: INI directive 'iconv.internal_encoding' is deprecated since PHP 5.6 (ini_get() only reads the setting; PHP reports this deprecation only when the directive is enabled or set, so reading it changes nothing)

INI directive 'mbstring.internal_encoding' is deprecated since PHP 5.6 (ini_get() only reads the setting; PHP reports this deprecation only when the directive is enabled or set, so reading it changes nothing)

Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): All previously accepted values for the $type parameter of iconv_set_encoding() have been deprecated since PHP 5.6. Found 'internal_encoding'

INI directive 'safe_mode' is deprecated since PHP 5.3 and removed since PHP 5.4 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)
Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): Function get_magic_quotes_gpc() is deprecated since PHP 7.4 and removed since PHP 8.0

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$hash" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 2115. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)
